hypothesis: Per-device Ubuntu paste compatibility sends V with Control+Shift after successful non-ASCII sendText; observed B modifier order and 20ms server serialization are consistent with this. Actual Mac preference state and ordinary V events were not captured.
limits: User reported Chinese appeared normally; duplicate count was not asked or measured.
Cannot conclude original Shift+Insert failed, that client fallback was solely responsible, or that native server has no other regression.
No Mac or Linux product sources were modified.
